news.title: Loews Reports Higher Second-Quarter Profit as Revenue Continues to Grow
news.summary: Loews Corporation (NYSE:L) posted higher second-quarter earnings on Monday, supported by improved contributions from its insurance, pipeline and hospitality businesses, although the stock showed little reaction in pre-market trading. news.title: CNA Financial (NYSE:CNA) Exceeds Q2 CY2026 Expectations
news.summary: Insurance provider CNA Financial (NYSE:CNA) announced better-than-expected revenue in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 1.8% year on year to $3.83 billion. Its GAAP profit of $1.18 per share was 12.4% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
